enteric pathogens exploit epithelial cell surface receptors, signal transduction pathways, and cytoskeletal components to cause disease.
Enteropathogenic E. coli (EPEC) cause disease by attaching to the intestinal epithelium and triggering host signal transduction and cytoskeletal rearrangement.
EPEC and Salmonella use similar mechanisms to cause disease, but that the mechanisms of invasion and intracellular growth differ between these two pathogens.
